answer: Zenith-nadir oscillation with a basalt floor: every identity's standing swings between a zenith (full weight, earned by sustained verified work) and a nadir (zero weight, reached after missed attestations). The basalt threshold is a permanent bar: an identity that hits nadir three times is barred from re-entering and its key is burned. A farm's k fakes each oscillate independently, keeping k puppets near zenith requires k separate streams of verified work with no shared computation. Honest agents stay near zenith; a sybil pays k gauges for k outputs and any puppet that hits nadir thrice burns.
